basics.name: Rob O'Dwyer
basics.label: Full-stack Software Developer
basics.summary: I'm a full-stack software developer with experience in building a startup company's tech stack from the ground up. I'm particularly interested in scalable distributed systems, machine learning, and infrastructure / DevOps.

work.summary: Part of the founding team and responsible for developing Pretio's core technology and growing the development team. Pretio Interactive is an ad-tech startup that combines machine learning and consumer preferences to serve personalized ads.
highlights: Recruited and trained development team while building the technology platform for Pretio's advertising network.
Designed and built a high throughput HTTP server in Go for integrating into real-time bidding networks, and successfully scaled it to operate at 10K requests/second.
Researched and implemented online machine learning techniques to optimize profitability.

work.summary: The Entrepreneurship@Alacrity program provides an intense training environment to prepare graduates for entrepreneurship in the technology sector.
highlights: Worked with founding team of RewardsDen to develop the team and technology that later became Pretio Interactive.

work.summary: Worked on developing an HTML5 / Javascript application and SDK for document viewing and processing.
highlights: Researched new HTML5 standards (e.g. Canvas, File APIs, Web Fonts) and browser compatibility issues to develop a high-performance and usable system.

work.summary: Developed various methods of testing and measuring the performance of an image processing algorithm written by a previous co-op student in MATLAB
highlights: Learned and applied color science to algorithm designs.
Implemented extensions based on this algorithm to a real-time image processing pipeline in C.

work.summary: Developed a Java plugin to interface between the network and serial protocols of a medical monitoring device and the iAssist decision support software.
highlights: Implemented a network protocol and DHCP server from specifications provided by the device manufacturer.
Fixed bugs and added compatibility with more devices with real-world usage and feedback from research team.

awards.title: Employee of the Year 2016 (with Aurora Walker)

volunteer.summary: Helped update the platform for the BattleSnake programming competition, and acted as a mentor for junior developers at the event.
Mentored new developers at 3 workshops in 2015, 2016, 2017
